terra.problem: This implies all of Jacob’s sons were born in Paddan-aram, but Benjamin’s birth is described after Jacob left Bethel (Genesis 35:16–18). Genesis 35:26 itself describes Jacob’s sons as born in Paddan-aram.
The statement that Egypt appears later in Genesis needs a reference to a passage outside Genesis 36.
“Nothing got left behind” goes beyond the text. It says Esau took his livestock, other animals and property acquired in Canaan.
Genesis 27:36 records Esau speaking to Isaac about the blessing, not a fight between Esau and Jacob.
Genesis 36:20 says Seir’s sons were living in the land, but does not say they were already there when Esau settled.
“Wrong mountain, friend” says “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The cited verses, 1 Kings 18:19–20, describe the gathering at Carmel, not the showdown itself. The reference should include the verses that describe it.
Exodus 19:20 does not support the statement that God gives the law at Sinai. A passage such as Exodus 20:1–17 would support it.
